summary.name: SummaryTube
summary.one_liner: A Chrome extension and web tool that generates AI summaries, key moments, and transcripts for YouTube videos.
use_cases: Summarize a YouTube video before watching
Extract key moments from a long video
Get a transcript of a YouTube video
Ask questions about a video's content
Review top comments on a video
summary.what_it_does: The page describes SummaryTube as a tool that gives AI summaries of YouTube videos, with key insights, key moments, and transcripts. It is offered as a Chrome add-on with an "Add to Chrome" button and a Google sign-in. The free tier is described as install-and-use at no cost, and a paid Pro tier at $2/month is listed with 1,000 credits per month, unlimited video length, key moments, transcripts, and Q&A. Pro is also described as supporting top comments, 25+ languages, and no ads.
notable: Chrome extension for summarizing YouTube videos
caveats: Pro tier is $2/month and limited to 1,000 credits per month
Some features such as unlimited video length, Key Moments, transcripts, and Q&A are listed under Pro
